items.title: Housewife
items.mood: Confident, sassy It’s the #1 song in the U.S. right now, and every Reel on its audio page is from the last two weeks. The format to copy is the @kevinbannier_ choreography, done as a duo. Creators also use it for “morning mantra” lip-syncs and night-out fit checks.
items.best_for: dance studios, fitness instructors, fashion boutiques, hair and makeup artists, nightlife venues

items.title: Angel Of My Dreams
items.mood: Dreamy, glossy This is the most active sound on this week’s list. Nearly half the Reels on its page were posted in the last week. It suits “too pretty to be real” moments, and brands are already using it. @australia used it for a Melbourne city Reel, and jewelers are using it for ring unboxings.
items.best_for: tourism boards and tour operators, hotels, nail artists, jewelers, hair salons

items.title: November Rain
items.mood: Epic, nostalgic The month’s name is in the title, so it comes back every November. Creators use the guitar build for cinematic travel montages and 90s nostalgia. Some also post “then vs. now” memory edits, like “1992, we played it on repeat.”
items.best_for: videographers and photographers, travel creators, car dealers and detailers, illustrators, vintage stores

items.title: All I Want for Christmas Is You
items.mood: Festive, joyful Every year, November 1 is when this song comes back, and the “it’s time” memes start. Service businesses are already using it for booking pushes. One salon’s “have you booked yet?”
items.best_for: hair salons, nail and lash studios, gift shops, restaurants taking holiday bookings, travel agencies

items.title: Santa Tell Me
items.mood: Playful, festive The “it’s timeeee” countdown sound. Ten of the Reels on its page were posted October 26–29, mostly countdown clips and “time to watch Christmas movies” posts.
items.best_for: cafes, bookstores, candle shops, cinemas, home decor stores

items.title: Underneath the Tree
items.mood: Bright, festive This is the brand-launch sound of the holiday season. In the last week it carried a restaurant’s giant polar bear unveiling, a city ice rink opening, and tree reveals with shop links.
items.best_for: restaurants and bars, home decor stores, gift and toy shops, event venues, local city guides

items.title: Hold On, We're Going Home
items.mood: Smooth, nostalgic The song is climbing the U.S. Spotify chart again, and nine of its Reels on the page were posted October 26–29.
items.best_for: lash and brow studios, equestrian and sports coaches, gyms, real estate agents, coffee shops

items.title: Blue Moon
items.mood: Glossy, upbeat A fresh sound that beauty creators picked up this month. Every Reel on its page is less than three weeks old. It’s used for self-care routines, lip-combo tutorials, and salon how-tos. @australia used it for a Brisbane skyline Reel.
items.best_for: hair salons, skincare and beauty brands, makeup artists, fitness studios, tourism boards

items.title: Dame Hombro
items.artist: Bulin 47, Kevin Wai, Breyco En Producidera
items.mood: Playful, high-energy A dembow track that’s in the TikTok top 10 right now. The move is “dando hombro,” a shoulder shimmy, and teams are doing it together to start the week. One esthetician turned it into a joke about scanning everyone’s skin.
items.best_for: estheticians and med spas, restaurants and bars, retail teams, dance studios, Latin food brands

items.title: Everlong
items.mood: Driving, emotional The slow-building guitar is made for “how it started vs. how it’s going” stories. A Salem shop used it to show the empty building it moved into, then the finished store. Sports teams are using it for senior-night recaps.
items.best_for: independent retail shops, car detailers, contractors, high school and local sports teams, gyms

items.title: Linger
items.mood: Wistful, cozy The 2026 remaster is back on the U.S. Spotify chart, and Reels are following. Creators use it for fall digicam diaries and “my life is a movie” clips. It’s soft enough for slow, personal content.
items.best_for: cafes, photographers, pet groomers and pet shops, bookstores, knitwear and fall fashion brands

items.title: Sunshine (Instrumental)
items.mood: Sunny, easygoing An instrumental with no lyrics, so it sits under talking and on-screen text without competing. Its biggest Reels this week are quick tips: a hydration water recipe (643K plays) and a career tip for people over 50 (over 1M plays). Later also lists it for the “taking one for the team” group-role format.
items.best_for: nutritionists and wellness brands, personal trainers, career coaches, pet businesses, family brands

analysis.week_summary: 'Housewife' by Tate McRae leads Instagram Reels this week (Heat 87). 4 seasonal or returning sounds are back (All I Want for Christmas Is You, Underneath the Tree, Santa Tell Me). The best opportunity right now is 'Housewife': high heat and not yet crowded.
key_takeaways: Reels × Ireland crossover: 'Housewife' (#1 in Ireland), 'Nicole Kidman' (#12 in Ireland), 'Angel of My Dreams' (#43 in Ireland). These are the strongest local signals.
10 of 14 tracked sounds are rising: move early on 'Housewife', 'Patient Zero', 'Nicole Kidman'.
'All I Want for Christmas Is You' already has 1M+ reels, so you need a strong hook to stand out.
Most major-label songs may be blocked for Business accounts: reuse the same formats with original audio or a voiceover.
analysis.ireland_signal: Also charting in Ireland: Housewife (#1), Nicole Kidman (#12), Angel of My Dreams (#43). Irish acts in the top 20: Fontaines D.C., Kingfishr, Amble. Good material for Irish-pride content.
